caption:
GTA 6's first week in 6 numbers 📊 Every one checked in at least two sources.

$3.79B in pre-orders + day one (Take-Two). 118 perfect scores out of 147 reviews. 80 hours to beat. 30 FPS, even on PS5 Pro. 3.3M peak viewers on Twitch. 8 Game Awards nominations.

All 10 numbers, explained: new video on our YouTube, Vice Replay (link in bio).

Which number surprised you most? 👇

Sources: Take-Two 8-K (Nov 20), TechPowerUp, GamesRadar, PC Gamer, Dot Esports, VGC.

Fan page, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

#gta6 #gtavi #gta #gaming #rockstargames #ps5
first_comment: Full 10-number breakdown is on YouTube now: Vice Replay 📺

tips.title: $3.79 billion
tips.text: Pre-orders + day one, says Take-Two. GTA 5's day one in 2013: $800 million.

tips.title: 118 perfect scores
tips.text: Out of 147 critic reviews on PS5 in launch week. Metacritic: 99.

tips.title: 80 hours
tips.text: Rockstar's estimate for the story plus some side missions. GTA 5: about 32.

tips.title: 30 FPS
tips.text: Even on PS5 Pro. GTA 5 runs at 60 on the same console.

tips.title: 3.3 million
tips.text: Peak viewers on Twitch. It beat League of Legends' 3.11M record for one game.

tips.title: 8 nominations
tips.text: The most at The Game Awards 2026. Winners: December 10.
